The '''Delmaas system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the [[Delmaasi pirates/Legends|Delmaasi pirates]].<ref name="EGtW" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Delmaas system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square M-18.<ref name="EAOC" />
